tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google now lets you generate and edit Docs files directly inside Gemini chats on the web, Confirmed by The Verge.
An early Anthropic member recalls burnout and big ambitions during the artificial intelligence lab's early days, Confirmed by Business Insider.
OpenAI has rewritten its artificial intelligence rulebook around five core values to prioritize human intent and agency, Confirmed by The Next Web.
Nvidia faces Department of Justice scrutiny over its $13 Billion Hugging Face acquisition over artificial intelligence competition concerns, Reported by Tekedia.
FuriosaAI raises $620m at a $2.9bn valuation to scale its Nvidia rival chips globally, Reported by The Next Web.
Free every hour.
